player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Sigmar''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.

starting.card: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire

cards: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire
posted: There is no try/ oppressive enforcement
posted: 2 there will be hell to pay
notes: Posted 29 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting Stuff: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire ('Rallitir OP'), Prepared Defenses ('Pre Def'), Ralltiir ('rallitir'), Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO'), Mobilization Points ('Mob. points') and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.

Generic sites Forest, Jungle and Spaceport Docking Bay and the Ralltiir system dested the Dark pages; 'vaders with saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber (earlier 'Vader with Saber' ruling); 'dr. evazan/ ponda buba' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; '4-lom with gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'there will be hell to pay' dested There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'frist strike' dested First Strike; 'S&D' dested Search And Destroy; 'YCHF' dested You Cannot Hide Forever.
Posted 'battle plan' in a Dark deck dested Battle Order (Battle Plan is the Light counterpart); the 2001 Effect, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield.

Posted '3 dreadnoughts' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; '2 chimaeres' dested Chimaera; 'zuckass in ship', 'bossk in bus', 'dengar in ship' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Dengar In Punishing One; '5 tempest scouts' dested the generic Tempest Scout.
Secret Plans is a 2001 Effect (not the Reflections III Defensive Shield), counted in the 60.
'D docking bay' and '4 St-St pilots' do not name a card and are printed as posted (likely Death Star II: Docking Bay, and some Imperial pilot character).
